Wire Restore UI into ProfilePanel data controls next to Export. Full unit tests. Internal-first: WebCrypto, no deps.

L1.recipe: importLocalDataExport with envelope validation + replace mode + tests; minimal ProfilePanel restore button.

L2.recipe: L1 + integrity digest, merge mode, dry-run preview UI, legacy (un-enveloped) export acceptance.
